frozen_target.question: In the D=d=L=1 range left between the bounded-M owner and the Round-151 TTY corridor, does the actual-profile character wave P_U=sum_(ell>0 odd)chi_4(ell)ell^(-3/4)A_(1,M,U)(1,ell)e(sqrt(Nell)) satisfy |P_U|<<X^epsilon; if not, what is the first exact character-loss, square-resonance, Mellin-conductor, source-hypothesis, endpoint, or all-scale obstruction?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Let N=floor(X), R=X^(1/4), D=d=L=1, E asymp M, and Q asymp R^2M^(-1/2). Round 151 proves S_U=e(-1/8)N^(1/4)P_U+O(RX^epsilon), with the literal coefficient B_(1,U)(1) retained in the row. Bounded M and M^819>>R^1424 are already owned. Round 152 freezes 1<<M with M^819<<R^1424 and asks for |P_U|<<X^epsilon.
quantities: Retain the exact actual Round-148 compact profile, zero extension, derivative and transition ledger, stationary buffers, tails, endpoints, and the coefficient B_(1,U)(1).
Absolute summation of P_U has capacity M^(1/4)X^epsilon, so the requested signed gain is exactly M^(1/4) at unit profile scale.
Test adjacent odd pairing with chi_4(4n+1)=1 and chi_4(4n+3)=-1 without replacing the resulting finite difference by an uncontrolled derivative.
Test one legal A-process. Even shifts are compulsory and the character product becomes a constant sign; record the resulting phase, length, diagonal, and power before claiming character gain.
For ell=ts^2, retain t squarefree, the exact actual weight W(ts^2), all endpoints, and the resonance Nt equal to a square; sum both the exact and near-square families.

For Mellin or functional-equation routes, derive the spectral parameter, transform width, dual length, gamma and root-number factors, and decide whether the transform reconstructs the accepted reciprocal row.
Audit second-, third-, and higher-derivative estimates and all current source-legal character-sum or subconvexity inputs with exact R-M powers.
Separate raw term count, weighted absolute capacity, signed character mass, exact square products, and near-square products.
The D>1 recovery fibre, L>1 components, growing-M generic sector, every t>=2 layer, and the independent Round-138 cross owner remain separate unless the same proof explicitly controls them.

Audit the bounded/intermediate/TTY boundary, N parity, exact N ell square, near-square spacing, profile transitions, and all R-M powers.
Source-audit every imported character-sum, exponent-pair, L-function, theta, or resonance theorem against the literal wave.
Close under exactly one label: square_root_wave_target, strict_square_root_character_range, or square_root_wave_no_go.

review_seams.requirement: The exact P_U wave retains the actual profile, B_(1,U)(1), zero extension, endpoints, and subtracts only bounded M and the TTY-owned range.
Adjacent odd pairing and every legal A-process track the mod-four character, shift parity, diagonal, endpoints, and resulting phase exactly.
The ell=ts^2 split, exact Nt square family, near-square spacing, actual weight, and all t,s ranges are completely summed.
Every Mellin, functional-equation, Poisson, Voronoi, or B-process step has the correct conductor, transform width, dual length, constants, root number, endpoints, and actual-profile norms.
Every external theorem matches the literal wave and every R-M power is independently checked across bounded, intermediate, and TTY boundary scales.
Absolute capacities are not signed lower bounds, and D>1, L>1, generic, t>=2, Round-138 cross, M1, M2, endpoint, M9, bridge, target, and exponents are not promoted without complete owners.
